Chapter 2 - Telephone Terminals / Telephone Terminals Reference
Constants

Display Items

The index parameter of the TELGetDisplay function and the value parameter of the telTermDisplayMsg message specify a text item on a display. The Telephone Manager defines the following constant for a display item. Telephone tools may support other display item values. 
enum {
   telEntireDisplay        = 0
};
Constant descriptions
telEntireDisplay
The entire display.
Note
Display item values in the range 1 through 255 are reserved for use by the Telephone Manager. Display item values in the range 256 through 32768 are available for use by telephone tools.
